summary: Sh. Ali Mashhour continues his explanation of Al-Wajeez in the book of purification, focusing on the Islamic practice of tayammum (purification with dust) when water is unavailable or inaccessible. He discusses the conditions under which tayammum is permissible and obligatory, citing Quranic verses and hadith narrations from Sahih Bukhari and Sunan Abu Dawud. A significant portion of the lecture centers on a hadith about companions who gave incomplete religious advice to a man with a head injury, resulting in his death. Sh. Ali Mashhour uses this incident to emphasize the distinction between mere factual knowledge and true scholarly understanding—highlighting that knowledge requires knowing the nuances, context, and limitations of one's own understanding rather than answering questions without proper expertise.
